text: KE Holdings priced its IPO on August 12, 2020 at $20 per American depositary share and closed its first day at $37.44. The shares peaked at $76.69 on February 22, 2021, fell to a low of $9.00 on March 14, 2022, and closed the five years at $18.37 on August 20, 2025, 8.1% below the offer price, before dividends. Its filings show transaction volume falling sharply as home-market policy tightened, and a loss for 2021.
